name: blinding gaze
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.
